description:
Companies reporting earnings soon, with the date, time (before open / after close) and countdown, joined with
recent insider activity. With only_with_insider_buying=true it answers 'which companies reporting soon have
insiders been buying?' — insiders buying ahead of a report is a rare and closely watched signal. Also use for
'when does X report?' (pass tickers=['X'], only_with_insider_buying=false).

days_ahead.description: Companies reporting within this many days (1–60).
days_ahead.title: Days Ahead

only_with_insider_buying.description: True = only companies where insiders made open-market purchases in the look-back window (the 'edge' list).
only_with_insider_buying.title: Only With Insider Buying

data_as_of.title: Data As Of

disclaimer.default: Public-record data for research and education. Not investment advice. Insider trades can be routine (pre-planned 10b5-1 sales, taxes, diversification); correlation is not causation.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
